integrity: Proof, exact covariance identities and a standalone rational-enumeration checker included; numerical tests do not replace infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed shelf count and insertion bias; common-assignment coupled prefixes only. No independent audit or definitive historical priority. One-deck inversion CLTs were previously studied; Tripathi full article was inaccessible during this review.
title: Exact orthogonal prefix increments and a cubic-clock Gaussian process for asymmetric shelf shuffles
